info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Workforce Training Management API
info.description: The Workforce Training Management API enables organizations to efficiently update and manage workforce training records. This endpoint allows for modifications to existing training programs based on evolving business needs. Ideal for HR professionals and training coordinators, the API supports streamlined adjustments to personnel training data, ensuring compliance and enhanced employee development. Use this API for real-time updates to workforce training initiatives that align with corporate strategies and growth objectives.

patch.description: This endpoint allows developers to update specific workforce training resource details, identified by the resource ID. Ensure all required data is provided in the request for a successful update.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the workforce training information for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. It allows for modifying various fields related to training operations, enabling adjustments to be made based on new information or requirements.
